decisions.reason: The original release is restricted to research/education use. GTNB provides CC BY 4.0 historical injection-production process and quality records that can teach distribution shift without widening iGuzzini rights.
The learning skill is multivariate anomaly review, not a source-specific quality class. Governed GTNB process/quality channels support a fail-closed outlier lesson under CC BY 4.0.

A source-native categorical quality class is not required for the intended association lesson. GTNB exposes governed process variables and direct/source-derived quality outcomes without inventing a class label.
GTNB can support comparison of similar historical process records with different quality outcomes while keeping causal claims explicitly unsupported.
The evidence-boundary lesson is stronger with open process/quality records: measured association can be shown while root cause remains unsupported.
Choosing the next discriminating measurement can be taught from an incomplete open process/quality record without relying on research/education-only production data.
FHJ is CC BY-NC and product-scope use is not assumed. 4h98 is CC BY 4.0 and contains direct repeated mechanical-property replicates suitable for spread/repeatability teaching.
4h98 provides multiple direct physical outcome replicate families under CC BY 4.0, supporting measured outcome comparison without importing noncommercial rights into the product.
The evidence-boundary objective is that material/mechanical test evidence cannot by itself establish a production root cause. Direct 4h98 mechanical replicates support that lesson under CC BY 4.0.

boundary: This file does not promote any learner case. Rebalancing removes licence-blocked dependencies from the release curriculum while preserving the original sources in the evidence ledger and retaining their rights restrictions. Each replacement case still needs a distinct source window, case-specific wording, novelty review and independent engineering review.
